response.reconstructed_markdown:
There isn't a single universally agreed\-upon "Number 1" whey protein in India, as the title shifts depending on whether you look at global legacy/overall preference, local domestic sales volume, or specialized categories like budget or isolate.

However, the market is overwhelmingly dominated by a couple of top contenders:

- [Optimum Nutrition \(ON\) Gold Standard 100% Whey](https://dir.indiamart.com/ahmedabad/on-whey-protein.html): Widely regarded as the global gold standard and the default premium pick for serious lifters and gym\-goers in India. It is consistently one of the most trusted and sought\-after international brands for quality and mixability.
- MuscleBlaze \(Biozyme Series / Whey Gold\): As India’s leading homegrown sports nutrition brand, MuscleBlaze frequently ranks as a top domestic best\-seller. Its Biozyme range is specifically clinically tested and patented for the Indian dietary body type to ensure better protein absorption and digestion.
- Avvatar Whey Protein: Another massive homegrown favorite proudly made in India \(by Parag Milk Foods\), highly rated for being 100% vegetarian, sourced directly from fresh cow's milk, and delivering a high protein count per scoop without digestive bloating.
- [AS\-IT\-IS Nutrition](https://asitisnutrition.com/blogs/health/top-5-budget-friendly-whey-protein-in-india-2025): The undisputed leader when it comes to the budget and raw whey segment in India, popular among students and beginners looking for lab\-tested, unadulterated protein at a lower cost per gram.

If you let me know your budget, fitness goal \(muscle building, weight loss, or general fitness\), and whether you prefer raw/unflavoured or flavoured powder, I can recommend the exact right brand and variant for you.
